exercise1.prompt: Group by time period without building the key yourself.

hiddenCases.name: two rows in one month make one bucket
a single row is a single month
resample does the bucketing
hiddenCases.describe: resample rather than a group-by on the month

exercise1.hint: resample("MS") buckets by month start. The quiet month in the middle is the whole point: a group-by would skip it and the timeline would lie.

questions.prompt: What does resample do that a group-by on the month does not?
choices: Produces every period in the range, including empty ones
questions.explain: A group-by only knows about months that have rows. A chart drawn from it silently closes the gap where nothing happened.

questions.prompt: What does resample need to work?
questions.explain: It buckets on the index, so the index has to be time. That is what set_index was for in the previous lesson.

questions.prompt: Why does an empty period matter on a chart?
choices: A gap closed up makes a quiet period look like it never existed
questions.explain: The reader sees a continuous line and assumes continuous activity. That is a chart telling them something untrue.
